Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value From activities Inner Join assays On activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id Inner Join molecule_dictionary On activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno Left Join compound_structures On molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno Filter activities.standard_relation = '=' And activities.pchembl_value Is Not Null And assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' And target_dictionary.tid = 4478 Order By molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id Limit 1000
